purpose: Pre-register how the project will interpret Qwen 3B smoke outcomes before the paid run, so success criteria, negative-result handling, and model-escalation decisions cannot move after seeing results.

hard_rejections: Citation syntax or inline-citation rate alone cannot count as success.
A result below 70% answer rate cannot count as support-preserving distillation, even if support rises.
A result without paid grounded-correctness judgments cannot count as quality evidence.
A result without remote provenance and actual cost cannot count as amortized deployment evidence.

decision_tree.paper_action: Do not discuss Qwen 3B quality. Keep all trained-student and amortized-success claims blocked.
decision_tree.next_engineering_action: Repair remote backend auth, run the bounded smoke, fetch predictions/result/report/smoke manifest, then run provenance and integrity gates.
decision_tree.allowed_followup_spend: GPU spend only after remote_backend_ready_for_qwen3b_smoke; no paid judge until predictions pass integrity and dry judge.

decision_tree.paper_action: Report no support-preservation claim from predictions alone. Local overlap/citation syntax metrics are diagnostics only.
decision_tree.next_engineering_action: Run remote provenance, prediction integrity, dry judge, and then paid grounded-correctness judge if budget remains under $100.
decision_tree.allowed_followup_spend: Paid judge spend only after integrity_gate_ready and dry_judge_full_coverage.

decision_tree.paper_action: Report the trained Qwen smoke as a negative result. Do not claim support-preserving amortized distillation; update the Pareto table and analyze whether failure is support, coverage, citation, abstention, or JSON/format related.
decision_tree.next_engineering_action: Run failure-mode audit before any larger model or second GPU run. Do not escalate to a cutting-edge model unless the failure mode is capacity-bound rather than data/contract-bound.
decision_tree.allowed_followup_spend: No additional GPU spend without a new decision log entry, failure-mode audit, and budget recheck.

decision_tree.paper_action: Claim only minimum support-preserving evidence: Qwen beats the direct baseline at >=70% answer rate, but does not beat the 70% coverage-constrained frontier. Report this as partial amortization, not a dominant result.
decision_tree.next_engineering_action: Update Pareto, rerun loss accounting, rerun novelty/risk artifacts, and decide whether one bounded follow-up is justified by specific frontier gaps.
decision_tree.allowed_followup_spend: One follow-up only if total planned spend stays under $100 and the follow-up targets the measured frontier gap.

decision_tree.paper_action: Claim support-preserving amortized grounded QA only with model-judged caveats, provenance, actual cost, novelty refresh, and private-KB scope limitations.
decision_tree.next_engineering_action: Update Pareto, budget, amortization, loss accounting, manuscript, reviewer-risk audit, final claim matrix, and run final novelty refresh.
decision_tree.allowed_followup_spend: Avoid more GPU runs unless reviewers require a direct baseline; preserve budget for final judge/adjudication.

larger_model_allowed_only_if: Qwen failure-mode audit shows capacity-limited answer repair rather than citation syntax, data construction, or abstention-threshold failure.
A new budget gate shows total OpenAI plus external compute spend remains below $100.
The larger run has a bounded smoke plan with the same final-window, judge, provenance, and Pareto requirements.
A decision-log entry records why Qwen 3B was inadequate and what the larger model tests that Qwen did not.
prohibited_escalations: Do not rent a cutting-edge GPU only to improve headline metrics after a negative Qwen result.
Do not treat a larger base model without trained adapter/provenance as a substitute for the planned Qwen smoke.
Do not use tiny/local model outputs as ground-truth labels.

manuscript_policy.if_negative: Submit only as a negative/diagnostic study if the rest of the paper is framed around why current post-training/scaffold recipes fail to preserve support under update-heldout KB states.
manuscript_policy.if_minimum_positive: Frame as partial amortization with explicit coverage/support frontier limits and model-judged caveats.
manuscript_policy.if_strong_positive: Frame as support-preserving amortized grounded QA over a public dated domain-KB proxy, not private-enterprise proof, and still refresh novelty at submission time.

llm_budget.note: This policy reads local artifacts only and makes no calls.
